lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, primarily organized into three distinct horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with primary blobs to create a lattice-like visual structure, most prominent in the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal ridge feature visible on the upper flank, displaying a high-contrast transition from high pixel intensity on the superior surface to a shadow-defined inferior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin in the lower quadrant exhibits a dense concentration of smaller spots along the anterior margin, transitioning to larger, more sparse blobs towards the posterior edge.
